title: Mixing Times of Switch Chains via High-Dimensional Expansion
summary: The switch chain is a Markov chain defined on the set of labelled realizations of a given graphical degree sequence. At each step, a pair of vertex-disjoint edges is chosen at random and the process attempts to replace them with a uniformly chosen perfect matching of the same four vertices, rejecting any proposal that would create a multiple edge. The resulting process is reversible with respect to the uniform distribution on all realizations.
